newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Five of bridal party die in Bangladesh road crash.
newsitem.headline: Five of bridal party die in Bangladesh road crash.

text.p: Five members of a bridal party were killed when their vehicle collided head on with a bus on a highway in the west Bangladesh district of Magura on Friday, police said.
They said eight friends and relatives of the bridegroom, whose name police could not give immediately, were also injured.
Both the vehicles were driving at high speed, police said but they were unable to say exactly what caused the accident.
